title: Validation: T7 - Capacity envelope + eviction threshold
description: T7.1: Document allocatable CPU/mem per node, max pods. T7.2: Ramp load until eviction/OOMKill — record max sustainable RPS. Sets safe operating limits for all experiments.
notes:
COMPLETED: T7 capacity envelope testing 2026-02-13.
THREE TESTS RAN:
1. T7a /health: 160k reqs, 819 RPS achieved. 0% HTTP errors. SLO threshold ~300 RPS for 2 pods. Saturation is queueing-based.
2. T7b /fib?n=25 aggressive: 30k reqs, 101 RPS achieved. 29.6% HTTP errors. Pods restarted from liveness probe failures at ~100 RPS.
3. T7c /fib?n=25 gentle: 21k reqs, 71.5 RPS achieved. 3.5% errors. p50=278ms (already above SLO). More pod restarts.

KEY FINDINGS:
- /health: SLO holds to ~300 RPS with 2 pods. No errors up to 3000 RPS target.
- /fib?n=25: SLO holds only to ~50 RPS with 2 pods. Pod instability at ~100 RPS.
- Zero OOMKill/Eviction events. Saturation is CPU-based (50m limit per pod).
- ClarkNet replay (24-179 RPS) fits /health but exceeds /fib capacity with 2 pods.

PHASE B RECOMMENDATION: Use /health for trace replay OR reduce fib scaling factor OR increase replicas/CPU limits.

ARTIFACTS: results/experiments/validation/2026-02-13_t7-capacity-envelope/ (meta.yaml, report.md, raw/)
close_reason: T7 complete. Capacity envelope documented: /health SLO ~300 RPS, /fib SLO ~50 RPS (2 pods, 50m CPU). No OOMKill/Eviction. ClarkNet replay fits /health. Report at results/experiments/validation/2026-02-13_t7-capacity-envelope/
